rules.statement: Abandonment of an incumbency by a priest constitutes the forfeiture of that to which his pupils' rights of succession are attached, namely the incumbency itself.
rules.supporting_quote: The abandonment of an incumbency by a priest, on the other hand, constitutes the forfeiture of that to which his pupils' rights of succession are attached, namely the incumbency itself. The priest remains a priest, but abandons his rights to the incumbency, upon which the pupillary rights of succession are dependent.
